title: Increase the field through a loop
hook: Change magnetic-field magnitude and predict magnetic-flux magnitude.
misconception: magnetic-flux magnitude stays fixed when magnetic-field magnitude doubles.
objective: Apply flux magnitude = B A abs(cosθ) to compare magnetic-flux magnitude when magnetic-field magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed planar area and fixed field angle to its normal, flux magnitude = B A abs(cosθ). When magnetic-field magnitude doubles, magnetic-flux magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model flux magnitude = B A abs(cosθ); scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed planar area and fixed field angle to its normal, with a nonzero initial result. If magnetic-field magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on magnetic-flux magnitude?
recall.why: Apply flux magnitude = B A abs(cosθ) under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
